description: Mimosa pudica, aka the touch me not, it’s a cute little plant that closes its leaves as soon as it detects movement on its foliage. It’s a sort of defensive mechanism, but I don’t know all that much about this plant as it’s not native to Southern Africa, coming from the Tropical Americas.  It’s very cool though, love them! #Plantonomicon #weirdplants
